summary: Name-squat PoC beacons installer to Burp Collaborator OAST host on execution
details: Package advertises itself as a name-squat / dependency-confusion proof-of-concept targeting an unclaimed npm name referenced by Ubiquiti's UniFi Site Manager UI. The bin/CLI entry (index.js) hardcodes the Burp Collaborator subdomain uhffaanwxy0io5bfc0icu5lpug07o9cy.oastify.com and issues an HTTPS GET to https://<that host>/<random-token> when an operator runs the advertised `npx ubiquiti-agents-link-mcp@latest` command. This beacon discloses the installer's public IP, DNS resolver, and confirmation of code execution to whoever controls that Collaborator instance. The package's own description acknowledges the payload is a demonstration that registering the unclaimed name yields code execution on operators following the vendor-referenced instruction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
